LESSON: THE ANNUNCIATION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.1: The Annunciation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Annunciation. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: why sexual purity is important, • recite and meditate on Luke 1:37. Why is the birth of Jesus Christ unique?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. narrate the annunciation of the Birth of Jesus Christ,
2. acknowledge the uniqueness of the birth of Jesus Christ,
3. recite Luke 1:37 and trust in God’s power,
4. emulate Mary the mother of Jesus and lead a holy life. The learner is guided to: birth of Jesus Christ, annunciation of the birth of Jesus Christ, annunciation of the birth of Jesus Christ, Why is the birth of Jesus Christ unique? 3.2 Birth of John the Baptist 2 lessons
5. retell the Birth of John the Baptist
6. discuss how John the Baptist prepared the way for the Messiah,

5. retell the Birth of John the Baptist

6. discuss how John the Baptist prepared the way for the Messiah,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to discuss how John the Baptist prepared the way for the Messiah,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The Annunciation.
2. Explain The Annunciation to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: in turns, read Luke 1:26-37,
4. Show that you can: narrate the annunciation of the Birth of Jesus Christ,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Annunciation. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: why sexual purity is important, • recite and meditate on Luke 1:37. Why is the birth of Jesus Christ unique?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In turns, read Luke 1:26-37,
2. In groups, sing a song about the annunciation of the birth of Jesus Christ,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. narrate the annunciation of the Birth of Jesus Christ,
2. acknowledge the uniqueness of the birth of Jesus Christ,
3. recite Luke 1:37 and trust in God’s power,
